problems.text: Users want better ways to find past meetings

proposed_solutions.text: A search feature for past meetings
Launch search for Enterprise only first, to keep it simple and give a reason to upgrade

user_segments.text: A large prospect that uses Standard and Enterprise plans depending on the department

requests.text: A large prospect specifically asked for search
Search on all plan levels, which the Sales Lead says was promised to the prospect
Position search as an Enterprise differentiator to help the pricing story

disagreements.text: The Sales Lead wants search on all plans because of the promise to the prospect. The PM proposed Enterprise only first, and the Product Marketing Lead says putting search on all plans loses upsell momentum.

open_questions.text: Which plan levels get search at launch: all plans or Enterprise only? The PM is not committing to either and wants leadership to decide.

action_items.text: Document the conflict and get leadership to decide

metrics_mentioned.text: The deal with the large prospect is worth $200K annually
The prospect needs an answer by end of week
